notes: All scientific definitions and ordinary prose are unchanged from v12, except the S6v9 filename. The3main and2supplement equations remain native editable OfficeMath.

The arithmetic signature preserves fraction/script/accent structure and every source token while allowing dynamic-delimiter containers to become literal parentheses and legacy nary-body boundaries to expand. Separate checks require complete final summands, so this equivalence proof does not accept an incorrectly truncated summation operand.

RiskB contains the complete D(P0,Pj) function inside nary/e, with both P subscripts and bounds j=1..4. Kitagawa C/W both contain their full mean-rate/mean-weight fraction inside nary/e; only terminal punctuation stays outside.
All automatic m:d delimiter objects and all5 formula-layout tables are absent. Literal parentheses are ASCII normal-math text explicitly using Times New Roman.
All66main/878supplement scientific tablecells, author metadata/abstract, Results/declarations/references/captions and embedded image bytes are preserved. S6PDF bytes are unchanged.

No inference, resampling or statistical experiment was run. This is structural/content verification and this environment PDF checking, not a direct WPS or MicrosoftWord runtime test. Full visual review is separately documented.
